title: Founders Week prep and staff prioritization lab v0.1
body:
Purpose / scope:
- Prep doc for Founders Week (internal all-team week) and a lightweight prioritization lab for staff+exec to align Q2 bets.
- Goal: produce an executable 6-week focus plan with 3 company-level priorities, adoption metrics, owners, and a short comms/risks checklist for launch.

High-level agenda (two half-days):
Day 1 AM — State of the product and ops (30m each)
  1) CEO kickoff (15m): 1-line market thesis + 3 friction points we must remove this quarter
  2) GTM snapshot (30m): usage velocity, high-intent pilot pipeline, churn signal highlights
  3) Tech health (30m): p99 latency trend, infra cost delta vs. plan, live incidents since last all-hands
Breakout 1 (60m): 
  - Prioritization lab: 4 cross-functional tables (runtime, platform, product, GTM)
  - Exercise: each table lists 6 candidate initiatives (10m to capture), then dot-vote (20m), then impact/effort mapping (30m)
  - Deliverable: top 2 initiatives per table with a raw RACI stub and suggested metric(s)
Day 1 PM — Exec synth + early bets (90m)
  - Exec roundtable: synth outputs, pick company top 5 candidates for day 2 deep-dive
  - Quick operational asks and resource constraints review

Day 2 AM — Deep dives (4 x 30m)
  - Owner presents plan, milestones, risks; group convenes to pressure-test and sign off on go/no-go
  - Criteria for sign-off: measurable metric, owner, 6-week milestone cadence, fallback plan
Day 2 PM — Finalize 6-week focus (90m)
  - Consolidate into a single 6-week focus plan doc
  - Comms run-through for company announcement and manager toolkit
  - Post-mortem cadence and who runs weekly check-ins

Draft company-level priority candidates (brain-dump) — these are intentionally broad; pick 3: 
- Priority A: Reduce median generation latency by 25% on hosted API for common prompts (owner: eng-serving-runtime)
    - Suggested metric: median token latency at 2k prompt share, and customer reported latency NPS
- Priority B: Close enterprise pipeline gaps: 3 signatures from pilot accounts for Dedicated/Private (owner: sales+solutions)
    - Suggested metric: signed ARR from pilot cohort, time-to-first-successful-deployment
- Priority C: Launch Optimize beta with 10 paying customers (owner: product-optimize)
    - Suggested metric: revenue from Optimize, avg cost savings per customer
- Priority D: Reliability play: reduce partial-degradation incidents by 80% via graceful fallback policies (owner: sre)
    - Suggested metric: number of incidents with customer-visible degradation per month
- Priority E: Developer DX: publish SDK v2 with streaming and function-calling improvements + new quickstarts (owner: devex)
    - Suggested metric: adoption rate in free-tier projects and time-to-hello-world

Prioritization lab mechanics (for facilitators)
- Pre-reads (send 48 hours before): 1-pagers for each candidate initiative, current metrics snapshot, and resource heatmap
- Dot-vote rules: each participant gets 4 dots. Dots may be allocated across initiatives or concentrated. Visible voting (stickies) for psychological safety.
- Impact/effort map: 4-quadrant flipchart. Impact = customer/business upside; Effort = engineering+ops+GTM work weeks.
- Tiebreakers: executive sponsor preference, measurable short-term win, or dependency unblocker effect.

Operational checklist (pre-week)
- Logistics: rooms booked, AV checks, remote link + latency test (owner: ops)
- Pre-reads: consolidated into a single doc + one-slide summary per initiative (owner: Amina)
- Exec prep: rough 3-slide deck per speaker (deadline: 3 days before)
- Data snapshots: product telemetry, cost forecasts, sales pipeline export (owner: analytics)
- Facilitators: one facilitator per table (names below)

Facilitators / table leads (proposed)
- Runtime table: Jasper Liu
- Product table: Sana Reddy
- GTM table: Diego Marquez
- SRE / Infra table: Eve Thompson

Draft comms timeline (post-week)
- Day +1: Send company announcement email with 6-week focus, owners, and top-level metrics (owner: comms)
- Day +3: Manager toolkit and suggested 1:1 talking points (owner: people ops)
- Week +1: All-hands follow-up, add live FAQ channel on Slack (owner: comms + product)

Exec update (concise draft for CEO)
- TL;DR: Founders Week produced 7 candidate initiatives; execs recommend selection of 3 company-level priorities (A, C, D) to drive reliability, cost-effectiveness, and customer expansion.
- Why now: market sensitivity to latency/cost is increasing and enterprise pilots require predictable economics; early Optimize adopters show 3–5% run-rate savings in pilot data.
- Ask: approval to allocate 8 total FTE-weeks from infra and 6 from product over next 6 weeks; greenlight two pilot commitments for Dedicated sales motion.

Risks and open questions (for execs to resolve)
- Headcount friction: do we pull engineers off roadmap or hire contractors? (owner: CTO)
- Billing/price risk: if Optimize beta reduces customer spend, how do we preserve revenue neutrality? (owner: finance)
- Security/compliance gating for Private pilots: can we commit pilot timelines without SOC-2 stage gating? (owner: security)

Deliverables (post-week) — minimum viable handoff
- 6-week focus doc with owners, milestones, metrics (one-pager + tracker)
- Manager toolkit and slide pack for wider company announcement
- Weekly check-in cadence owner assigned and calendar invites out
- Decision log with vetoes/assumptions captured

Appendix: raw notes template for table facilitators (copy into each breakout doc)
- Initiative name:
- Short description (2–3 lines):
- Hypothesis: what will change and why it matters
- Success metrics (quantifiable):
- Key milestones (6-week window):
- Dependencies / blockers:
- Resource ask (FTE-weeks):
- Risk register (top 3 risks):
- Recommended fallback

Notes to self (Amina):
- Keep the session tight, avoid feature-level debates in breakout (force timebox)
- Encourage trade-offs — the point is to choose, not to list
- Prepare a one-slide template for the prioritization outputs so consolidation is quick

Unresolved items to fill before we circulate the final playbook (owners):
- Confirm room AV vendor and backup conferencing link (ops)
- Pull latest p99 telemetry and cost delta by model family (analytics)
- Compile sales pilot list and risk tier (sales)
- Legal sign-off checklist for pilot contracts (legal)
